text: BAM share fell 0.92 percentage points over 22 hours, and is down 0.79 percentage points over 7 days, to 31.8% of Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 24% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. Leadership changes remain best read as whale-driven routing, not structural rollover.
